cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'm filling the shared car log. What were the mileage, fuel level and driver after nine? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I mean all three blanks. Start with mileage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Driver I remember. The rest means going down six flights to the glovebox.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the book and bring you tea on the way back. Then you can give me the whole row in order.
